references.text: Joel speaks of sending out a sickle because the harvest is ripe, which resembles the image Jesus uses of sending out a drépanon when the grain is mature.
Moses' instructions about the harvest and reaping reflect the theme of waiting for the right time to harvest, which parallels Jesus' use of the harvest as an image for the right time for action.
Jeremiah also uses the image of harvest and reaping in a prophetic context, which can be seen as a precursor to Jesus' use of these images to convey spiritual truths.
Jesus speaks of the harvest being great but the workers few, which resonates with the image of the harvest being ready and the need to send out workers.
Revelation contains an image of an angel swinging his sickle over the earth to reap, a direct echo of the image Jesus uses in Mark 4:29.
